newsitem.title: USA: Calif. regulator okays FHP PacifiCare pact.
newsitem.headline: Calif. regulator okays FHP PacifiCare pact.

text.p: The California Department of Corporations on Friday said it had approved PacifiCare Health Systems Inc's acquisition of FHP International Corp.
The approval comes after five weeks of review and public hearings that focused on accessibility to care, continuity of care, quality of care and financial solvency, the commission said.
"It is the department's position that consummation of a financial transaction between health care organizations should in no way negatively impact enrollees," said Commissioner Keith Bishop.

He added the merger approval is only a first step in a lengthy process under which the companies are allowed to operate under common ownership, but their respective health care plans may not consolidate without department approval.
